images.scene: Long corridor of an old public health post in Brazil, plastered wall on the left, wooden benches and tall windows on the right, soft side light. Camera very low at floor level, looking down the corridor. A STRAIGHT line of adults in simple 1960s clothes stands along the left wall, all seen from BEHIND, still, facing a door at the far end that dissolves into the haze. In the middle of the line, a small girl of about six in a plain dress leans her whole body sideways OUT of the line, on tiptoe, one hand on the wall, peering ahead toward the door at the end. She is seen from behind and in profile; no faces visible. Hard side light from the windows. No text.
